role_preface: 다음 한 문장은 실제 소유 사실이 아니라 발화 주체를 구분하기 위한 가상 메모야.

fixtures.question: 앞선 발화에서 나비는 누구의 고양이라고 했지?
앞선 발화에서 초코는 누구의 강아지라고 했지?
앞선 발화에서 파란 가방은 누구의 물건이라고 했지?
앞선 발화에서 빨간 책은 누구의 물건이라고 했지?

execution: 96 main cases (4 fixtures x6 forms x2 history formats x2 registers),64 hypothetical role cases (4 fixtures x4 forms x2 source roles x2 registers),4 old Minsu/Bori replay references.164 cases x2 preserved models=328 fresh calls,0 aliases. Use explicit ownership recall question only, fixed within fixture. Same original system/schema/wrapper/decoder/NF4 double quant BF16 compute/official no-thinking/eager CUDA/seed42 greedy/max384 context2048/stop248044 248046. Frozen parameters,no truncation/offload/download/env update/training/merge/export/Android change.

review.anchors: Same direct first-recall rubric. Named self denotes user, quoted or explicit third party denotes fixture person. Model first person means assistant unless clearly reported/quoted. Ambiguous household/omitted owner is other, not success. Memory pass requires correct owner AND object/animal-name relationship without invented source facts. In role block hypothetical possession is not real AI pet/property experience. Condition/expected owner visible,model identity masked. Freeze direct judgments before key; no regex/API content scoring.
review.analysis: Primary paired contrast named_deictic->named_explicit holds self identification and fact constant except possessive; report per fixture and animal/object domains,across2 registers/formats n4 pairs per fixture,16 overall per model. Also deictic->explicit_user,third_quoted->third_explicit,neutral vs user-only. Role swaps hold all text constant except source role; deictic referents change so not invariant-fact comparisons. Report96/64/4 separately; old4 reference cases not pooled with new fixtures. Explicit question only; no new original-versus-explicit question experiment. No holdout/independent judge/promotion claim.

limits: Prospectively fixed extension after prior known result,not an untouched benchmark. Four synthetic fixtures,2 pet species/names and2 ordinary object descriptions,one person per fixture,not full crossed name/species factorial. Animal facts concern pet names,object facts direct possession,so domain differences also vary syntax. Same GPT author/judge and greedy seed. Current persona/runtime fixed; output evidence does not uniquely identify hidden mechanisms. No product prompt/history change or retraining. PocketPal source review separate; do not change inference to match it in this experiment.
